status: source verified and revised STRING/opaque starter schemas accepted by pinned live Kestra; end-to-end broker/native transport roundtrip remains E2/E3/E6
flow: fixed core.http.Request native_start -> core.flow.Pause await_result -> core.http.Request submit_result

initialInputs.sf_native_start: STRING canonical WorkerTransport JSON encoding logical WorkerRequest native.start

internalResultResume.sf_result: STRING canonical WorkerTransport JSON encoding logical WorkerRequest result.submit

runtimeObligations: E2 validates fixed engine configuration and refuses readiness on mismatch; recipe cannot override it
E2/E3 supplies only authenticated runtime-owned initial inputs, never recipe defaults or arbitrary browser inputs
E6 resumes await_result only after a genuine structured result; ordinary human replies go to native continuation
E2/E3/E6 supplies a fresh result capability for the current attempt/fence, not the original start capability
E3 validates WorkerRequest operation, scope, fence, immutable owner/provider, granted paths/tools and result authority
HTTP bodies pass pre-serialized opaque envelope STRING values directly, without toJson; RAW_PATTERN postprocessing cannot alter the base64url payload. Recursive rendering must still stay false
HTTP headers are rendered twice; capability alphabet is enforced before engine rendering
No redirects or non-200 broker responses are accepted; no caller-defined headers, proxy, logging, retries or TLS overrides
Engine completion and verified lifecycle quiescence are still required for closeout; native idle is not a result
E2/E6 must use encodeWorkerRequest before injecting reserved STRING inputs; E3 reads bounded raw body text and decodeWorkerRequest exactly once before logical authorization
E3 uses encodeWorkerResponse for all broker reply bodies; E2/E6 decodeWorkerResponse outside Kestra; never double-stringify the wrapper or recursively unwrap logical context
Historical JSON/toJson recipes are rejected by the updated exact graph policy and require an explicitly approved new revision

shape.payload: canonical unpadded base64url of UTF-8 logical JSON

transport.responses: Same canonical envelope; decode only in trusted broker/runtime, never inside Kestra expressions
transport.limits: Resource bounds per message; fail without truncation; not a context/token budget
